title: Your team settings screen
description: A tour of the Edit Team page: appearance, team details, players, leaderboards and deletion, and what changes when you are not the Owner.
body:
Everything you can change about a team is on one screen, Edit Team. The Owner and any Administrator can open it. A Player or a Fan cannot.

Open Edit Team and read it

  1. Open Teams. Select the menu at the end of the team's row and select Edit.

  2. Read the page. It is five cards, top to bottom.

  3. PROFILE APPEARANCE holds the banner and the crest, each with its own edit and delete control.

  4. TEAM INFORMATION holds the name, the team size and the bio. Nothing here is saved until you select Save Changes.

  5. TEAM PLAYERS lists everybody on the team with their role and their position, and is where you add somebody new.

  6. LEADERBOARDS shows the leaderboards the team has joined, and lets you add or remove one.

  7. DELETE TEAM is last, and only the Owner can use it. An Administrator sees the section with the button greyed out.

What you will see

Your own row in TEAM PLAYERS is marked (You) and has no menu. You cannot change your own role or take yourself off the team from here.

A member added by name rather than by email has no position and carries an Invite button instead.

If it does not work

  • The team's row has no Edit. You are a Player or a Fan on that team. Only the Owner and Administrators can edit it.
  • Delete Team is greyed out. You are an Administrator, not the Owner. Only the Owner can delete a team.
  • Your changes did not stick. The name, size and bio need Save Changes. The images do not - they save as soon as you apply the crop.
